name: Tucker J. Ruby
prior_offices: Johnson County attorney (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Tucker J. Ruby is the Johnson County attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Sheridan Media reported that he advanced from the 2026 primary and was selected in the general election.
